
# Exclude samples that will not be included from the analysis.

```{r}

library(phyloseq)



samples_to_remove <- c("CUI06R", "EN005R", "EN013R", "EN018R", 
                       "EN023R", "EN024R", "TZ5062R", "TZ5076M", 
                       "TZ5092R", "TZUI00R")


physeq_filtered <- prune_samples(!(sample_names(phy) %in% samples_to_remove), phy)

# Verify the filtered data 
physeq_filtered

phy <- physeq_filtered

phy
```

# Data preprocessing

## Remove contaminants

### Given that the presence of contaminants observed in QIIME View was negligible, only a filtered dataset will be used in this study.

```{r eval=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
filterPhyla1 <- c("Chloroplast", "Mitochondria", "Eukaryota", "d__Eukaryota", "Vertebrata", "Archaea", "Protista", "d__Archaea")
phy2 <- subset_taxa(phy, !Kingdom %in% filterPhyla1)
phy2 <- subset_taxa(phy2, !Phylum %in% filterPhyla1)
phy2 <- subset_taxa(phy2, !Class %in% filterPhyla1)
phy2 <- subset_taxa(phy2, !Order %in% filterPhyla1)
phy2 <- subset_taxa(phy2, !Family %in% filterPhyla1)
phy2 <- subset_taxa(phy2, !Genus %in% filterPhyla1)
phy2 <- subset_taxa(phy2, !Species %in% filterPhyla1)
phy2 <- subset_taxa(phy2, Phylum != "unidentified")
phy2 <- subset_taxa(phy2, Phylum != "Unknown")

```

### Check how many ASVs were lost.

```{r}
ntaxa(phy)-ntaxa(phy2)
```

# Normalization using a rarefaction curve

```{r eval=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
otu_tab <- t(abundances(phy2))

rare <- vegan::rarecurve(otu_tab, 
                         step = 50, label = T)

phy.rar <- rarefy_even_depth(phy2, rngseed=1, sample.size = 10000, replace = F) 

phy.rar

```

### Check which samples were removed during the rarefaction process.

```{r}

# Obtain the sample names before and after rarefaction.
samples_antes <- sample_names(phy2)
samples_despues <- sample_names(phy.rar)

# Compare the samples that were removed.
muestras_descartadas <- setdiff(samples_antes, samples_despues)

# Display the list in the console
print(muestras_descartadas)
```

### Plot: Rarefaction curves


# Generate subsets of the phyloseq files by species.

```{r eval=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
Alouattapigra.bac <- subset_samples(phy.rar, Especie == "Alouatta pigra")
Alouattapigra.bac

Alouattapalliata.bac <- subset_samples(phy.rar, Especie == "Alouatta palliata")
Alouattapalliata.bac

Atelesgeoffroyi.bac <- subset_samples(phy.rar, Especie == "Ateles geoffroyi")
Atelesgeoffroyi.bac
```

# Calculation of Alpha Diversity metrics

```{r eval=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results = 'hide'}
phy.div <- alpha(phy.rar, index = "all")
phy.div

#create a table with the diversity metrics and metadata.

# extract the metadata from the phyloseq object.
phy.meta <- meta(phy.rar)
#Add the row names as a new column for subsequent table integration.
phy.meta$sam_name <- rownames(phy.meta)
#Add the row names as a new column to the diversity table.
phy.div$sam_name <- rownames(phy.div)
#Merge these two data tables into one
div.df <- merge(phy.div,phy.meta, by = "sam_name")
write.csv(div.df, "Alpha_diversity_metrics.csv", row.names = FALSE)

div.df
```

#Create subsets of the diversity data
